candidate: C3_flow = kappa^2 eta q - (1-a) kappa, from dp = kappa u - (1-a) x_lag and u = (1-eta) u_lag + eta q x_lag, x = 1e4 log price minus EMA(60 minutes), u = signed flow / flow scale (Part 7 and Part 14 definition)
data: Coinbase Exchange public REST trades (no account); minute bars of last trade price, signed taker notional (taker buy when the maker side is 'sell') and notional volume; a day is valid if >= 60% of its minutes have a trade; days with more than 400 pages of trades are dropped
flow_scale: each pair's median |flow| over training minutes with at least one trade
inclusion: a pair enters if it has >= 15 valid training days and >= 25 valid test days
inference: all thin-pair candidates are evaluated on the same rows (hours where C3_flow, C3_placebo, S60 and VPIN all exist) and the same 2,000 date-block bootstrap draws; Clark-West with 6 Newey-West lags; secondary Holm-adjusted
not_tested: no guard test on this venue (a certified operator needs three extra days per evaluation day)
placebo: C3_placebo = the same statistic with the flow series of the window circularly shifted by 180 minutes inside the window (prices unchanged): it keeps the window's flow distribution and, apart from one wrap point, its autocorrelation (order splitting), and breaks the minute alignment between flow and price; it uses no data from outside the window
primary_1: thin: MAE_60 | C3_flow beyond the baseline; Clark-West one-sided p and 95% date-block bootstrap CI of dR2
primary_2: thin: dR2(C3_flow) - dR2(C3_placebo), each beyond the same baseline on the same rows; paired 95% date-block bootstrap CI; p = share of bootstrap draws <= 0
question: On a venue never used in Parts 1-16 (Coinbase Exchange spot, USD pairs): (1) does the depth-free amplification margin C3_flow forecast the next hour's maximum adverse excursion beyond a volatility and price-impact baseline in thin pairs? (2) Is its content the minute-level alignment of flow and prices that the model describes, rather than the persistence of order flow (order splitting)? Test: the real statistic beats an order-splitting placebo.
runs: C6 is run once; every run is counted in prereg/test_set_unlocks_p17.json
secondary: thin: C3_placebo beyond the baseline (predicted: no gain)
thin: C3_flow beyond the baseline plus VPIN
mid control: C3_flow beyond the baseline
success: fixed-sequence testing, which controls the familywise error at 0.05: primary 1 passes if its p is below 0.05 and its 95% interval is above zero; primary 2 is tested only if primary 1 passes, and passes if its p is below 0.05 and its 95% interval is above zero (beating a placebo is informative only if the real statistic has content)
unit: pair x hour t in 06-23 UTC; features from minutes [t-360, t); outcome MAE over (t, t+60] in basis points

universe.rule: USD pairs online in 2026, excluding stablecoins and wrapped or staked tokens, with >= 20 daily candles in Dec 2023 and >= 25 in Jun 2024; thin = median Jun-2024 daily dollar volume $0.5M-$5M (up to 20 drawn, seed 20261134); mid control = $15M-$50M (up to 4 drawn)
